dryRunSetting.name: Migration Dry Run
dryRunSetting.hint: When on, data migrations run on load but only log what they would change — nothing is written and the migration version is not advanced. Turn off and reload to apply migrations for real.

initiativeModifier.title: Set Initiative Modifier
initiativeModifier.hint: A one-off situational adjustment for this combatant's initiative this round (e.g. a spell's casting time). Lower is better.

exceptionalStrength.name: Exceptional Strength
exceptionalStrength.hint: Warriors with Strength 18 roll d100 for an exceptional-Strength band (PHB p.18).

maxSpellsPerLevel.name: Enforce Spells Known Per Level
maxSpellsPerLevel.hint: Cap a wizard's spells recorded per spell level by Intelligence (PHB Table 4).

weaponSpeedInitiative.name: Weapon Speed Affects Initiative
weaponSpeedInitiative.hint: Add weapon speed factors and casting times to individual initiative. Requires Sub-project 3.

spellFailureFromWisdom.name: Priest Spell Failure
spellFailureFromWisdom.hint: Apply a priest's chance of spell failure from low Wisdom (PHB Table 5). (not yet enforced)

trainingRequiredToLevel.name: Training Required To Advance
trainingRequiredToLevel.hint: A character must spend time and money training before gaining a level (DMG optional rule). (not yet enforced)

nonweaponProficienciesUsed.name: Use Non-Weapon Proficiencies
nonweaponProficienciesUsed.hint: Enable the non-weapon proficiency system (PHB p.51). (this setting is not yet consulted — proficiency checks are always available once a proficiency is taken)

weaponProficienciesUsed.name: Use Weapon Proficiencies
weaponProficienciesUsed.hint: Enable the weapon proficiency system and non-proficiency penalties (PHB p.51). (this setting is not yet consulted — proficiency penalties always apply)

multiclassHpAveraging.name: Average Multi-Class Hit Points
multiclassHpAveraging.hint: A multi-class character's hit points are the averaged roll across classes (PHB p.44). (not yet enforced)

combatAndTacticsEnabled.name: Combat & Tactics: Enabled
combatAndTacticsEnabled.hint: Master switch for the Combat & Tactics option group. Individual rules below have no effect until this is on.

criticalHits.name: Combat & Tactics: Critical Hits
criticalHits.hint: Natural 20s roll a critical-hit severity table for extra damage; natural 1s roll a fumble severity table (may drop a weapon or cause minor self-injury).

calledShots.name: Combat & Tactics: Called Shots
calledShots.hint: Target the head, weapon hand, or leg at an attack penalty for a location-specific effect (Combat & Tactics). A head shot's stun and a leg shot's prone have no automatic expiry — clear them manually from the target's Token HUD when appropriate.

combatManeuvers.name: Combat & Tactics: Combat Maneuvers
combatManeuvers.hint: Disarm, knock down/trip, grapple, and bull rush at an attack penalty (Combat & Tactics). Grapple's held condition has no automatic expiry — clear it manually from the target's Token HUD when appropriate.

armorTypeVsWeaponType.name: Combat & Tactics: Armor vs. Weapon Type
armorTypeVsWeaponType.hint: Weapon-type modifiers versus armor type (Combat & Tactics).

weaponMastery.name: Combat & Tactics: Weapon Mastery
weaponMastery.hint: Mastery and grand-mastery weapon tiers beyond specialization (Combat & Tactics).

skillsAndPowersEnabled.name: Skills & Powers: Enabled
skillsAndPowersEnabled.hint: Master switch for the Skills & Powers option group. Requires Sub-project 8.

subAbilityScores.name: Skills & Powers: Sub-Ability Scores
subAbilityScores.hint: Split each ability into two sub-scores (Skills & Powers). Requires Sub-project 8.

characterPointBuild.name: Skills & Powers: Character Point Build
characterPointBuild.hint: Buy class and race features with character points (Skills & Powers). Requires Sub-project 8.

expandedProficiencies.name: Skills & Powers: Expanded Proficiencies
expandedProficiencies.hint: The expanded proficiency list and rules (Skills & Powers). Requires Sub-project 8.

spellsAndMagicEnabled.name: Spells & Magic: Enabled
spellsAndMagicEnabled.hint: Master switch for the Spells & Magic option group. Requires Sub-project 9.

spellPoints.name: Spells & Magic: Spell Points
spellPoints.hint: Cast from a spell-point pool instead of fixed slots (Spells & Magic). Requires Sub-project 9.

expandedCastingTime.name: Spells & Magic: Expanded Casting Time
expandedCastingTime.hint: The expanded casting-time and interruption rules (Spells & Magic). Requires Sub-project 9.

channelers.name: Spells & Magic: Channelers
channelers.hint: The channeler wizard variant (Spells & Magic). Requires Sub-project 9.
